Unit 7 — Level Building & Ladders

The editor becomes a paint tool and the game becomes a place. Tilemaps, colliders, sorting layers, and the design theory — flow, pacing, difficulty curves, signposting — that makes a big cave buildable and fair.

IDTitleWhat you build / learn
7.1aTilemaps: The Level Editorgrid, palette, paint — drawing instead of placing

Concepts this unit owns

Level design as data-driven storytelling: flow, pacing, and signposting are claims about the player's attention. The beat-granular playtest table here becomes Unit 9's dataset. CED: CRD-1 (design before code), DAT-2 (collecting playtest data), IOC-1 (designing for humans).
